items.item_text: Under direction of the Senior Contracts and Grants Manager and/or Associate Director, work with academics and staff from a specific set of Statewide Programs, Research and Extension Centers, and Cooperative Extension to review complex research contracts and grant proposals prior to submission to sponsors; negotiate research agreements with sponsors.

Represent the Office of Contracts and Grants at workshops and seminars to inform and explain/discuss campus policies and procedures governing the responsibilities of Research Administration. Approves reviews conducted by entry-level analysts. Approves/signs-off submission of pre-award update information requested by sponsor representatives before issue of awards. Independently negotiates terms and conditions of complex research grant, contract and subcontract proposals and awards from various sponsors. Maintains appropriate approvals

from applicable compliance committees. Directs, initiates and designs analyses of federal, state, and university policy and assists with developing and writing office and organization policy and procedures.

Communicates/teaches research administration concepts at national meetings, organization or departmental. Maintains and develops professional relationships with sponsor representatives. Independently detects areas where new regulations need to be understood and implemented. Maintains communication with review committees to learn of new requirements.

Our goal at the Office of Contracts and Grants (OCG) is to provide principal investigators assistance with proposal preparation and with resources and expertise so that they may better understand contract and grant administration and successfully administer sponsored awards. The UC ANR OCG is the authorized organizational representative for all extramurally sponsored projects at UC ANR.
This position is a career appointment that is 100% fixed.

This position may be eligible for a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote work with on-site work at the designated office in Davis, CA. Candidates must be available to work on-site at least two days per week, with additional on-site work and travel as business needs require.
This job is open until filled. The first application review date will be 11/11/2026.
